The formula syntax's reading fixture (VLA.4). Each case sits under a line
"=== <name>" and its next line is a formula's text, as a formula row or
the formula bar holds it; these lines before the first header are ignored.
vla-lang/tests/formula_syntax.rs reads every case with formula_syntax::read
and writes formula_syntax_golden.txt's record of it: "VLA<TAB><the
canonical expression, printed flat>" and "TEXT<TAB><formula_syntax::write
of that expression>", or "REFUSED<TAB><the catalogue's id><TAB><the
refusal's text>". The reader has no VBA twin, as the evaluator has none,
so the golden is the port's own, written by the test under VLA_BLESS=1 and
read by a person before it is committed. A case is named for what it means
to reach.
=== a-row-of-buffet
=IF(B11=1,Day.last!$B$3+$B$6,Hustle.last!B13)
=== the-input-card-s-tally
=Tally.last!B1+IF(AND(Input!B1=1,Input.last!B1=0),1,0)
=== buffet-s-clock-text
=INT(B15/60)&":"&IF(MOD(B15,60)=0,"00","30")
=== sand-s-brush
=IF(IF(Gate!$B2<0,FALSE,(COLUMN()-Gate!$A2)^2<=Gate!$B2),Gate!$C2,0)
=== kairos-s-words-a-semicolon-in-a-text
=IF(State!B1=3,"Level "&State!B3&" stacked: Z goes on; X takes the minor.","")
=== buffet-s-dollars
=IF(Stocks!E5<1000,"  ","")&INT(Stocks!E5/100)&"."&IF(MOD(Stocks!E5,100)<10,"0","")&MOD(Stocks!E5,100)
=== a-number-as-written
=1.50
=== a-fraction-alone
=.5
=== an-exponent
=1E+05
=== a-sign-on-a-number
=-1
=== two-signs
=--1
=== a-sign-before-parentheses
=-(1)
=== a-sign-and-a-percent
=-5%
=== a-percent-of-a-sign
=(-5)%
=== a-text-with-a-quote-mark
="say ""hi"""
=== an-empty-text
=""
=== a-non-ascii-text
="▲"
=== truth-values-any-case
=AND(true,FALSE)
=== an-error-lower-case
=#n/a
=== every-error
=CHOOSE(1,#NULL!,#DIV/0!,#VALUE!,#REF!,#NAME?,#NUM!,#N/A)
=== references-of-every-shape
=SUM(a1,$B$2,C$3:$D4,e:E,5:$7)
=== a-quoted-sheet-that-needs-none
='Input'!B5
=== a-sheet-that-needs-quotes
='2026'!A1
=== a-sheet-with-a-space
='Q1 Data'!A1:B2
=== a-span-of-sheets
=SUM(Jan:Dec!A1)
=== a-span-with-a-space
=SUM('Jan 1:Dec'!A1)
=== a-twin-sheet
=Tally.last!B16
=== names
=Rate*Model!Local*tax_rate
=== a-name-behind-a-quoted-sheet
='Q1 Data'!Rate
=== spaces-dropped
= A1 + 1
=== redundant-parentheses-dropped
=((A1))+(2*3)
=== a-left-chain-is-one-form
=1+2+3
=== a-right-group-is-kept
=1+(2+3)
=== a-parenthesized-left-group-is-the-chain
=(1+2)+3
=== a-sign-then-a-difference
=-a-b
=== a-chain-of-comparisons
=a<b<c
=== excel-s-power-is-left-associative
=2^3^2
=== a-sign-binds-tighter-than-power
=-2^2
=== a-sign-on-a-power
=-(2^2)
=== concatenation-below-arithmetic
=1&2="12"
=== a-function-in-lower-case
=sum(a1:b2)
=== a-function-with-a-dot
=STDEV.S(A1:A9)
=== a-function-with-no-argument
=PI()
=== lambda
=LAMBDA(x,y,x+y)
=== let
=LET(x,1,x+1)
=== xor-and-type-are-excel-s
=XOR(TYPE(A1),1)
=== the-reference-error-alone
=#REF!
=== malformed-empty
=
=== malformed-a-trailing-operator
=1+
=== malformed-an-open-parenthesis
=(1
=== malformed-a-close-parenthesis
=)
=== malformed-an-open-text
="abc
=== malformed-two-operands
=1 2
=== malformed-an-open-call
=SUM(1,2
=== malformed-if-of-one
=IF(1)
=== malformed-not-of-two
=NOT(1,2)
=== malformed-a-comma-outside-a-call
=1,2
=== malformed-a-locale-separator
=SUM(1;2)
=== malformed-a-long-text
="aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
=== unsupported-an-array
={1,2;3,4}
=== unsupported-implicit-intersection
=@A1:A3
=== unsupported-an-intersection
=A1 B1
=== unsupported-a-union
=SUM((A1,B2))
=== unsupported-a-spill
=A1#
=== unsupported-a-structured-reference
=SUM(Sales[Amount])
=== unsupported-another-workbook
=[Rates.xlsx]Sheet1!A1
=== unsupported-an-omitted-argument
=IF(A1,,B1)
=== unsupported-a-file-spelling
=_xlfn.XLOOKUP(1,A:A,B:B)
=== unsupported-the-range-operator
=A1:INDEX(B:B,5)
=== unsupported-a-newer-error
=#SPILL!
=== unsupported-a-call-in-place
=LAMBDA(x,x)(1)
=== unsupported-a-broken-reference-behind-a-sheet
=Sheet1!#REF!
=== unsupported-a-function-named-like-a-form
=CALL(1)
=== unsupported-a-function-named-ref
=REF(1)
=== unsupported-a-function-named-last
=LAST(Input!B5)
